purpose: Validate whether a bound response dispatch request is structurally acceptable to its destination authority without invoking that authority or granting execution permission.

input_boundary.authority_context: provided only for authority classes modeled locally

semantics.request_preflight: must pass before authority-specific checks run
semantics.executor_ready: means the local preflight can prove the modeled destination authority would accept the request shape/context; it is not permission to execute

ignore.preflight: no-op route requires no executor state

request_information.authority_context: external authority is not modeled in this crate

propose_revision.method: clone ResolutionRevisionChain and call open_revision on the clone
propose_revision.executor_ready: true only when clone acceptance succeeds and original chain snapshot is unchanged

reverify.reason: runtime handle binding remains deferred upstream in response-dispatch-request.v1

surfaces.response_dispatch_executor_preflight: generic request + route preflight; never mutates authority state
surfaces.preflight_revision_dispatch_executor: revision authority preflight using a cloned ResolutionRevisionChain

output.request_ready: upstream dispatch request still matches current inbox/intent projections
output.executor_ready: authority-specific acceptance preflight succeeded where locally modeled
output.request_fingerprint: identity of the bound dispatch request being checked
output.authority_context: which concrete authority context was or was not available
output.simulated_effect: nonexecuting description of what the cloned/no-op preflight would accept

invariants: request preflight must pass before executor-specific checks
no revision is opened on the caller-owned chain
revision acceptance is simulated only on a clone
a stale request cannot reach authority-specific preflight
external authority absence remains explicit instead of guessed
runtime reverify remains deferred until real handle binding exists

next_boundary.rule: only a preflight-ready revision request against the same chain may enter the mutation adapter

future_extensions: runtime verifier handle binding and executor preflight
execution receipt rejoin as typed evidence

graph_typed_binding.execution: explicit real-handle execution available through canonical workspaceVerifyGraphReceipt
